name: edifabric-mcp
description: Validate, parse, build and acknowledge X12 and HIPAA EDI files locally with ediFabric Native.
long_description: Lets Claude work with X12 and HIPAA EDI files on your computer: validate them up to HIPAA SNIP level 4 and explain each error, convert EDI to JSON and back, generate 999 and 997 acknowledgments, split files into transactions, and describe any transaction's structure. Files stay on your computer; only the license check and the transaction type and version of the models leave it.

tools.name: parse_edi
tools.description: Convert an EDI file to JSON

tools.name: validate_edi
tools.description: Validate an EDI file up to HIPAA SNIP level 4

tools.name: build_edi
tools.description: Convert EDI JSON to an EDI file

tools.name: split_edi
tools.description: Split an EDI file into one file per transaction

tools.name: describe_spec
tools.description: Describe a transaction's structure, or make a JSON skeleton to fill in

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Show the license, the models and the allowed folders

serial.title: ediFabric serial key
serial.description: Your serial from https://www.edifabric.com/account.html. Leave it empty to try the server with the demo serial, which has a small daily quota.

allowed_folder.title: EDI folder
allowed_folder.description: The folder the tools may read and write.
